_comment_physics: Large-box dendrite: δ=0.65 moderate undercooling for slower, more structured growth. ε=0.15 strong cubic anisotropy. Perturbed seed gives <100> arms a head start.
_comment_grid: 384^3 ≈ 56.6M cells × 64 B/cell ≈ 3.6 GB — fits comfortably in T4's 16 GB with room for CUDA runtime and I/O. dx=0.4 gives physical domain 153.6³.
_comment_time: dt=0.005 with Heun on 27pt has 4.3× stability margin. max_steps=40000 = 200 τ₀ of simulation time. The saturation guard will exit cleanly when the dendrite reaches the wall.
_comment_output: VTK every 1000 steps. 384^3 VTS ≈ 880 MB each, expect 10-20 frames before saturation = 9-18 GB on disk.
_comment_checkpoint: Checkpoint every 5000 steps (384^3 checkpoint ≈ 864 MB), keep_last=2 = ~1.7 GB on disk.
_comment_initial: r0=10 cells = 4 W₀, well above critical nucleus. Perturbed seed adds cubic-harmonic bumps along <100> directions to jumpstart the 6 dendrite arms instead of waiting for Mullins-Sekerka instability.
